conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and concentrating on income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan aims for a potential ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration.
